> recalibrated on real residuals.

- Trained: 2026-10-16T12:07:13+00:00 | seed 42 | model: lightgbm
- Data: 12 flats x 30 days hourly (hash `c0e02c47747fb59e`); target =

| metric | model | naive seasonal (same hour last week) |
|---|---|---|
| MAE (L/min) | 0.1422 | 0.1686 |
| RMSE (L/min) | 0.2112 | 0.2585 |

CV MAE per fold (model / naive): 0.1722 / 0.1722, 0.1362 / 0.1662, 0.1549 / 0.1807
